title: 3.5 mm eductor optimization per unit motive air
status: Analytical screening with independently reported OpenFOAM qualification
objective: Min-size clean high-shear powder delivery divided by total motive-air mass flow. Keep useful coverage and outlet first-sticking probability visible separately.

definitions.useful: Fraction of all releases that reach the outlet and ever exceed the absolute shear target. No minimum dwell time is imposed.
definitions.clean: Weighted outlet/high-shear indicator times exp(-integrated collision hazard), using the frozen-background first-sticking model.
definitions.probability: Mean first-sticking probability conditional on outlet arrival; worst of two separately simulated monodisperse sizes.
definitions.air: Sum of motive-air mass flows across all active nozzles, g/s. Entrained carrier air and compressor electricity are not included in this denominator.
definitions.intervals: Approximate 95% sampling intervals, not model uncertainty or selection-adjusted confidence.
definitions.parallel: Total powder is split evenly, each module is re-solved at reduced powder feed. An equal-pressure outlet/receiver with negligible coupling is assumed; post-merge coagulation and losses are not predicted.

limitations: Native nozzle discharge coefficients are family-specific (0.82 branched, 0.94 British).
The new radial-feed concepts use uncalibrated junction and entrance-loss closures.
Large transport-closure differences prevent a robust geometry optimum from being inferred from sampling alone.
Most high-shear collision dose lies outside the kernels’ applicability screen. Probabilities are comparative estimates, not validated agglomerate fractions.
Narrower release lanes do not model higher local concentration caused by physical focusing.
Local-time-stepping CFD is a steady convergence method, not a particle residence-time clock.
First-order single-mesh CFD is a screening comparison; mesh convergence and experimental coagulation evidence are still required.

geometry.name: Eight radial powder feeds · 22 mm bore
geometry.scope: Unbuilt fluid domain: 8 independent equal-pressure powder carrier ports, each diameter 5.657 mm and length 40 mm, at x=14 mm. Main bore diameter 22 mm, length 50 mm. A common upstream distribution manifold and its losses are not resolved. Analytical circuit has a nominal entrance loss; this difference must be reported, not fitted away.
